keywords.Quick: Can attack immediately on entering your battlefield.
keywords.Guard: If a ready Guard is in the attacked district, the defender must block with a ready Guard.
keywords.Steady: Does not exhaust when attacking, but still attacks at most once per turn.
keywords.Siphon: After combat, restore composure equal to damage this Neighbor actually dealt, capped by the target remaining health or composure.
keywords.Pierce: When blocked, attack damage beyond the blocker health plus armor reaches the defending player.
